name: gamb-variaveis
description: Tokens e estilos compartilhados do GAMB Design System.

scripts.build: npm run build:palette && npm run build:core && npm run build:extras
scripts.build:palette: sass --no-source-map --style=expanded src/gamb-palette.scss dist/gamb-palette.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/gamb-palette.scss dist/gamb-palette.min.css
scripts.build:extras: sass --no-source-map --style=expanded src/themes/gamb-personal.scss dist/themes/gamb-personal.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/themes/gamb-personal.scss dist/themes/gamb-personal.min.css && sass --no-source-map --style=expanded src/compat/gamb-legacy.scss dist/compat/gamb-legacy.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/compat/gamb-legacy.scss dist/compat/gamb-legacy.min.css
